title: Quiz on User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and BDD

questions.text: According to the reference material, what is the standard format for a User Story?
questions.explanation: The reference material explicitly states the format: 'As a (type of user), I want to (perform some action) so that I (can achieve some goal/result/value).'

answers.text: As a (type of user), I want to (perform some action) so that I (can achieve some goal/result/value).
Given (a context), When (an event occurs), Then (an outcome is expected).
The system shall (perform an action) when (a condition is met).
I need (a feature) because (a reason).

questions.text: What is the main purpose of Acceptance Criteria in relation to User Stories, as stated in the document?
questions.explanation: The text asks, '¿Cómo nos aseguramos de que las User Stories se han completado correctamente y conforme a las demandas de los clientes?' and then introduces 'Acceptance criteria' as the answer.

answers.text: To ensure User Stories are completed correctly and conform to client demands.
To define the technical implementation details of a User Story.
To prioritize User Stories for development.
To identify new user needs for future development.

questions.text: In the context of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), what is a 'behavior' primarily defined as?
questions.explanation: The text states: 'Un behavior (comportamiento) es cómo un feature que opera dentro de un escenario bien definido de entradas, acciones y resultados.'

answers.text: How a feature operates within a well-defined scenario of inputs, actions, and results.
The technical architecture of a software component.
A list of user interface elements.
The performance metrics of a system.

questions.text: According to the BDD guidelines on avoiding assertion language, which of the following scenario titles is considered a 'Bad example'?
questions.explanation: The document explicitly lists 'Bad example!' titles that use 'Verify', 'Assert', or 'should'. 'Verify the user can change their address on the profile page.' is given as a bad example.

answers.text: Verify the user can change their address on the profile page.
Profile page address change.
A stock quote has green text when its value is higher than its previous closing value.
Logout displays the goodbye page.

questions.text: For the 'Scenario: usuario envía el formulario de feedback con datos válidos', which of the following is NOT an expected 'Entonces' (Then) outcome after the user orders 'Enviar feedback'?
questions.explanation: The text states the 'Then' outcomes are: 'el sistema envía mi feedback', 'el sistema muestra el mensaje “Su feedback fue enviado con éxito”', and 'el sistema limpia los campos del formulario “Brindar feedback”'. The option about redirecting to the homepage is not mentioned.

answers.text: The system sends the feedback.
The system displays the message 'Su feedback fue enviado con éxito'.
The system clears the fields of the feedback form.
The system redirects the user to the website's homepage.
